claims.quote: If chlamydial infection has not been excluded, treat for chlamydia with doxycycline 100 mg orally 2 times/day for 7 days.

claims.text: If ceftriaxone isn't available: gentamicin 240 mg IM + azithromycin 2 g PO (single doses), or cefixime 800 mg PO single dose
claims.quote: Alternative Regimens if Ceftriaxone Is Not Available Gentamicin 240 mg IM in a single dose plus Azithromycin 2 g orally in a single dose or Cefixime* 800 mg orally in a single dose

claims.quote: If IgE-mediated penicillin allergy is strongly suspected, dual treatment with single doses of IM gentamicin 240 mg plus oral azithromycin 2 g can be administered (885,886).

claims.quote: If a patient is asymptomatic and the treating facility is able to perform gyrase A (gyrA) testing to identify ciprofloxacin susceptibility (wild type), oral ciprofloxacin 500 mg in a single dose can be administered.

claims.text: Pregnancy: ceftriaxone 500 mg IM single dose (+ chlamydia tx if not excluded);
claims.quote: Pregnant women infected with N. gonorrhoeae should be treated with ceftriaxone 500 mg in a single IM dose plus treatment for chlamydia if infection has not been excluded.
Gentamicin use is cautioned during pregnancy because of risk for neonatal birth defects, nephrotoxicity, or ototoxicity (897).
